hypotheses.justification: This characteristic assumption follows from [CharP E p]: since M and E are fields, the algebra map M → E is injective, so `charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap M E).injective p` supplies the instance. Thus, after removing this binder, the proof can install the derived instance locally wherever `theta` or its supporting lemmas need it; the conclusion and all other hypotheses remain unchanged. Injectivity also covers characteristic zero, so there is no exceptional zero-characteristic case.
